title: Faccio, vado, sto: i tre irregolari
summary: The essential irregulars fare, andare, and stare - daily routines, a vs in, and how you're doing

blocks.title: Fare: il verbo che fa tutto
blocks.body: **Fare** (to do/make) is irregular and everywhere: *faccio, fai, fa, facciamo, fate, fanno*. It shows up in fixed expressions that don't literally mean 'make': **fare colazione** (to have breakfast), **fare la spesa** (to do the grocery shopping).
blocks.callout: fare colazione isn't 'make breakfast' in the English sense — it's just the Italian way to say 'have breakfast.'

blocks.title: Andare: a o in?
blocks.body: **Andare** (to go): *vado, vai, va, andiamo, andate, vanno*. The tricky part is the preposition: use **a** with cities and specific places (*vado **a** Bologna, vado **a** scuola*), and **in** with countries, regions, and enclosed spaces (*vado **in** Italia, vado **in** ufficio, vado **in** treno*).
blocks.callout: a = a specific point (city, school); in = a bigger or enclosed space (country, office, vehicle).

blocks.title: Stare: come stai?
blocks.body: **Stare** (to be/stay, for feeling and location): *sto, stai, sta, stiamo, state, stanno*. Its most common job is answering **come stai?** (how are you — informal) or **come sta?** (formal): **sto bene** (I'm well), **sto male** (I'm not well).
blocks.callout: essere is what you ARE; stare is how you're DOING right now.

blocks.prompt: Complete: Vado ___ scuola tutti i giorni.
blocks.explain: **a scuola** — a with a specific place like school.
**vanno** — one of the forms you simply have to learn by heart.

blocks.scene: Giulia and You compare Saturday plans.

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.target: Allora, cosa fai di bello sabato?
lines.en: So, what nice thing are you doing Saturday?

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Faccio la spesa la mattina, poi vado in piazza.
lines.en: I do the grocery shopping in the morning, then I go to the square.

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.target: Io sto a casa la mattina, ma poi vado a lavorare in studio.
lines.en: I stay home in the morning, but then I go to work at the studio.

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Come stai questa settimana? Tutto bene?
lines.en: How are you this week? All good?

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.target: Sto benissimo, dai! Solo un po' stanca.
lines.en: I'm doing great, come on! Just a little tired.

questions.q: How does Giulia say she's feeling?

blocks.prompt: Write 2-3 sentences about your typical Saturday using fare, andare, and stare.
